basis: User rejects unrequested Qwen selection and requests literature/vendor/core-variable necessity review before model spending.
core: Compare software/computer-related and AI-related work using common measures of skill requirements and which accumulated experience is requested, without presupposing opposing effects. Historical identification is separate from extraction.

findings.literature: Deming-Kahn keyword categories; Deming-Noray vendor skill fields and dictionary grouping; Babina-He-Jiang author replication uses dictionary matching with LLM-assisted dictionary categorization, not proof of generic experience-relation extraction.
findings.vendor: Official Revelio September1 2026 article already measures skill breadth, years performing specific skills, AI use responsibilities. These cannot be claimed unique project variables.
findings.delivery: 19 Wuzhen annual Job Postings files inventoried2008-2026,95,857,646,722 bytes. Actual columns not yet verified; separate bounded scheduled metadata audit requested.
findings.scope_error: The 3-object small-model contract excludes tool-specific experience although this is relevant to the common research framework. Do not let model limitations set research scope.

next.unique_claim: No claim that experience relations are exclusive to our data or require LLMs. Novelty must be economic comparison/measurement demonstrated against available vendor fields.
